thread:
elaine: FYI seeing intermittent SSE reconnect dup-charges for a couple tenants. pattern: client reconnects quickly, edge proxy socket in CLOSE_WAIT, backend creates new session with same resume token -> double count.

mike: do we have a minimal repro or traces?

elaine: sampling hides most cases. snippet: client CONNECT X-Resume-Token: tkn1 -> proxy creates session (token_hash=sha256(tkn1)) -> proxy socket CLOSE_WAIT ~30s -> client retries CONNECT same token -> backend accepts new session.

sana: streaming trace sampling is 1%. can we tag `stream_handshake_linger` and force-sample those flows?

oliver: also emit metric `resume_token_duplicate_attempt` per-tenant and show dedupe-rate in console per-route.

mike: root cause? proxy half-close lifecycle or backend acceptance logic?

elaine: initial hypothesis: TLS rekey/half-close leaves socket lingering at proxy; backend defensively accepts new CONNECT if it sees a token.

oliver: short-term mitigation: routing dedupe window for identical resume tokens (e.g., 60s) behind a runtime flag. downside: may swallow valid reconnects.

sana: rollout plan: 1) add `stream_handshake_linger` tag + force-sample; 2) emit per-tenant `resume_token_duplicate_attempt`; 3) add console alert when rate > 0.1% sessions.

mike: capture `tcp_state` and `socket_age_ms` in traces too. limit forced-sampling to tenants with >3 duplicates in 10m to control trace volume.

elaine: i'll open a small PR on edge-agent to set the tag and export socket state. will hash tokens in traces.

oliver: console UX: add streaming reliability card in per-route view with dedupe rate, avg linger, and link to trace snippets.

analytics-bot: note: targeted forced sampling estimated +2% trace volume.

mike: add runbook steps for flipping per-tenant sampling and disabling dedupe flag.

sana: i'll update dashboard and alert panels.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy/agent@rev-c3d4e -> staging.

elaine: will monitor staging post-deploy and post numbers. tagging @sana for dashboard follow-up.
